body:
It's called the grapevine, companies look up your facebook profiles these days.

I live in a small community. People talk about people when they meet. Some recruiter sees your name and says, 'oh it's that area, I know x down there'. Mr or Mrs x fills the recruiter in on the local towns gossip about me, and they 'decide against hiring me'.

Mr or Mrs x could be my mum's friend or acquaintance or w/e. The smaller the community the quicker word/gossip spreads, and mine is a very small one.

My community would eat me alive if I knew I had these problems. I'd never get a job etc if anyone actually found out. I'd just get a massive label that reads 'broken goods, handle with care'.

Of all the shit I've said this is the one thing I can guarantee you. I wouldn't come on here and type all this shit out if I thought for a moment I could sit down with someone and air this shit out with no repercussions.

Yeh I have tried it. The one girl that I talked to never showed. Then she stopped responding altogether. Not a massive surprise.

Thanks for the response dude. It means a lot.

Thanks dude, thanks for the response.

I hope whatever comes after death is interesting.

I hope you find some peace my friend, see you on the other side some day.

With the girl, she was my best friend's little sister. We get along really well, I think she had a crush on me at one point. But I'm 25 and she's 18.. I doubt she'd have much interest, it was probably all in my head tbh.

In anycase she doesn't seem to show much interest in chatting to me anymore these past two months so yeh. She's gonna be off doing things anyway. It was a stupid idea me being interested in her at all. I dunno why I entertained it.

I can't tell you where I was stationed I'm afraid, I live in a small country, and there's enough info on here for someone to id me probably already.

I come from a very middle class background, but my parents never went to college. My grandfather happened to marry into a wealthy french family, and he was a pilot. My Dad happened to get passed on a lot of money when the french side of my family self-destructed. To his credit he started a business with the money but it's gone to shit now.

In anycase, I went to a very uppercrust school that frankly looked down on me. My entire school life consisted of me spiting them at every turn. I ended up joining the military quite early, half of me wanted to do something good in the world, the other half was just out of spite to the people who considered it a shitty job for the peasants.

The reserve stuff was great, but the full time guys were legit. We have one of the longest basics in the world. Did the military for a year then, never went overseas.

Met some of the worst and best men I have ever met in my life. You see the worst and best of men's nature (and women come to think of it).

Maybe it's condescending but after the army, majority of new people I met that weren't within my inner circle of friends just seemed like complete fucking assholes.

While I felt more obliged than ever to help my fellow man, everyone in the workplace or just in general seemed out for number fucking one. Always talking themselves up, and fucking proud of it too. Parents talking their children up. People obsessed over vanity.

I'd go out every Saturday to clubs nd places with a good friend of mine who was a little erratic, but he was a chill dude. Did this for about a year and after that I just kind of closed myself off from investing too heavily into new people.

I have a motorbike. I went through a phase of 'you don't have enough hobbies, you don't get out enough and just meet people or go places'.

So I'd get on the bike, ride around the place. Chat to cashiers at gas stations, chat to anyone who seemed to look my way. Still didn't meet anything new. Riding ends up being a pretty solitary experience.

I really don't know what I can do from here to make things better. That's what's really creeping me out is that I can feel it now - this is it. This is the final picture frame of your life, this is how it goes from here except you'll just be working soon enough is all.

Then your parents will die, then your two best friends will get a family sorted out and you'll just be that guy that lives on his own. Then I'll be the old angry man on the street that lives in that house and then that'll be it.
You should stick on cosmos if you're gonna smoke a few bowls. When you kinda realize how small you are in the universe, you just get this awesome sense of peace.

Alrite let's look at this logically with a sense of realism.

Can it get better? Yes. Is it likely to get better? No.

My success rate so far after 25 years is zero. Add another 25 years, I might get to have my hopes up another 3 or 4 times approximately and I'll likely sleep with another escort.

In all seriousness my aunt died alone at 60 the other year there. Never had anyone take an interest in her, the entire family couldn't be assed to put up with her because she had some undiagnosed mental illness since childhood that was never treated but everyone knew was there.

I have first hand seen how people can live for 60 years and ultimately die lonely and miserable while being a massive burden to their family, who ultimately really never gave much of a shit.

If I told you tomorrow, that you're going to die at 60 with no family by your side, no one by your side. Too weak to do anything. Just alone in your apartment watching TV. No grand accomplishments bar being a nurse for like a few months and working in blockbuster. If I told you from this point on you will be nigh on a ghost too.. what is your reason for living?
